event: Nala asks what Dray knows of Crake, reaching for Undertow to refine her trunk as she listens.
A Mendicant, from the Carrowmouth notices: he drinks Talents' Water at a touch and sells it bottled.

memory.fact: Dray knows Crake from Carrowmouth watch notices: a Mendicant, who steals Talents' Water.
Dray knows Crake from Carrowmouth watch notices: a Mendicant, who steals Talents' Water.
Dray knows Crake drinks a Talent's Water at a touch, and sells it bottled in Carrowmouth.
Dray knows Crake drinks a Talent's Water at a touch, and sells it bottled in Carrowmouth.

event: The tide reaches the scrape over her ribs; it must heal before it refines, and the sting doubles.

memory.fact: Refining over raw, scraped skin heals it first, which slows the work and doubles the sting.
Refining over raw, scraped skin heals it first, which slows the work and doubles the sting.

event: Three lone Talented gone this year; he rides with four men, manacles and Lock-choking darts.

memory.fact: Dray knows three Talented have gone missing on the Carrowmouth road this past year.
Dray knows three Talented have gone missing on the Carrowmouth road this past year.
Dray knows Crake picks Talents who travel alone and have no one to miss them.
Dray knows Crake picks Talents who travel alone and have no one to miss them.
Dray knows Crake rides with four men who carry saltsteel manacles and darts that choke Locks.
Dray knows Crake rides with four men who carry saltsteel manacles and darts that choke Locks.

event: She opens her mouth to ask where he camps; at her throat, where a thread ends, a cold jolt hits.

memory.fact: Talking while refining splits Nala's hold; at the hard parts the tide wavers unless she goes quiet.
Talking while refining splits Nala's hold; at the hard parts the tide wavers unless she goes quiet.
Refining her throat, where a thread ends, jolts like her soles did, and must be ridden the same.
Refining her throat, where a thread ends, jolts like her soles did, and must be ridden the same.

event: The tide lurches from her grip, her well spills near dry, and the trunk's refining runs back undone.

changes.note: The throat's jolt spills her well near dry

memory.fact: If Nala's hold breaks partway, the unfinished refining runs back out of her skin, lost.
If Nala's hold breaks partway, the unfinished refining runs back out of her skin, lost.

event: Her skin prickles raw from hip to jaw; the scrape has closed, but the bruise beneath throbs.

changes.note: The lost refining leaves her skin raw over the deep bruise

memory.fact: The tide closed the scrape over Nala's ribs before it slipped; the deep bruise under it remains.
The tide closed the scrape over Nala's ribs before it slipped; the deep bruise under it remains.

event: Her mind is scraped thin, as after two limbs; she can refine no more tonight.

memory.fact: A refining lost partway wears Nala's mind as much as a finished one.
A refining lost partway wears Nala's mind as much as a finished one.

event: "You've gone white." Crake's camp is unknown; the drover was robbed near Grey Shaw.

memory.fact: Dray does not know where Crake camps, only that the drover was robbed near Grey Shaw.
Dray does not know where Crake camps, only that the drover was robbed near Grey Shaw.

event: The notices name his Talent Siphon, First Depth: never let him touch bare skin; his touch drinks.

memory.fact: The Carrowmouth notices name Crake's Talent Siphon, and say he is First Depth, like Dray.
The Carrowmouth notices name Crake's Talent Siphon, and say he is First Depth, like Dray.
The notices warn never to let Crake lay a hand on bare skin; his touch is what drinks.
The notices warn never to let Crake lay a hand on bare skin; his touch is what drinks.

event: A First Depth thief with four men and venom is a match for any lone Talent, she most of all.

changes.note: The Sea begins to fill her well as they talk

memory.fact: Dray judges a First Depth thief with four men and venom a match for any lone Talent.
Dray judges a First Depth thief with four men and venom a match for any lone Talent.
Dray judges Nala an especially rich mark for Crake, with a well as deep as hers.
Dray judges Nala an especially rich mark for Crake, with a well as deep as hers.

event: She'll prepare first; Dray, near smiling, keeps the cottage hers: better ready than soon.

memory.fact: Dray is glad Nala stays to prepare, and keeps the watch cottage hers for as long as she likes.
Dray is glad Nala stays to prepare, and keeps the watch cottage hers for as long as she likes.

event: At the Lantern a copper buys stew, bread and ale; she sleeps the night through at the cottage.

changes.note: Supper at the Drowned Lantern

event: Day five's dawn: rested and clear, the raw prickle gone, the bruise faded to a dull yellow ache.

changes.note: Her well is full by morning
A night's sleep heals her

memory.fact: By the morning of day five the bruise over Nala's ribs has faded to a dull yellow ache.
By the morning of day five the bruise over Nala's ribs has faded to a dull yellow ache.
A night's sleep restores Nala's mind whole after a lost refining, as after a finished one.
A night's sleep restores Nala's mind whole after a lost refining, as after a finished one.

event: Hob's hammer rings down the ford road; at the Lantern a copper buys porridge, bread and small beer.

changes.note: Breakfast at the Lantern

event: Back at the cottage she bars the door and keeps her mouth shut; Undertow rises into her hips.
Over the yellow bruise the tide eases the ache, and spreads slow and even over back and chest.

memory.fact: Refining the skin over Nala's bruised ribs on day five eased the ache under the bruise.
Refining the skin over Nala's bruised ribs on day five eased the ache under the bruise.

event: At her throat the jolt comes; she rides it like a wave, and the tide runs on up her jaw.

memory.fact: Refining in silence, Nala can ride the throat's jolt; trunk, neck and head take her an hour.
Refining in silence, Nala can ride the throat's jolt; trunk, neck and head take her an hour.

event: The skin round her eyes and lips burns worst of all; her eyes stream, and she holds.

memory.fact: The skin round Nala's eyes and lips burns worst of all to refine, and her eyes stream.
The skin round Nala's eyes and lips burns worst of all to refine, and her eyes stream.

event: After an hour the tide reaches her crown; her skin settles whole, one tight, cool shell.

changes.note: An hour refining her trunk, neck and head whole: a hard working

memory.fact: When the last of her skin is refined, it settles over her whole as one tight, cool shell.
When the last of her skin is refined, it settles over her whole as one tight, cool shell.
On the morning of day five Nala's skin is refined whole, scalp to sole.
On the morning of day five Nala's skin is refined whole, scalp to sole.
Trunk, neck and head together wear Nala's mind as much as two limbs, the day's whole share.

event: She sleeps an hour and a half, and wakes to a deep ache in her limbs: Water seeping into muscle.

memory.fact: With her skin refined whole, Nala's Water starts seeping into her muscles on its own, aching.
With her skin refined whole, Nala's Water starts seeping into her muscles on its own, aching.

event: A second breakfast at the Lantern and a whole jug drunk down; then back to the cottage.

changes.note: Meals at the Lantern morning and night through days five to eight

event: She calls up Earth anatomy, muscle by muscle, and starts with the short muscle at her thumb's base.

memory.fact: Guided by her Earth anatomy, Nala refines one muscle whole at a time, cleaner and faster.
Guided by her Earth anatomy, Nala refines one muscle whole at a time, cleaner and faster.

event: It cramps hard for a minute like a fist in her palm, then loosens, denser and stronger.

memory.fact: Each refined muscle cramps hard for a minute, then loosens, denser and stronger than before.
Each refined muscle cramps hard for a minute, then loosens, denser and stronger than before.

event: Hand, forearm, upper arm, then the right; both arms done by evening. She eats twice what she did.

memory.fact: Refining muscle leaves Nala eating twice what she used to, and thirsty all day.
Refining muscle leaves Nala eating twice what she used to, and thirsty all day.

event: On day six Hob's boy knocks: her spear is ready at the forge.

memory.fact: When Nala does not come for it, Hob sends his boy to her cottage on day six to say it is ready.
When Nala does not come for it, Hob sends his boy to her cottage on day six to say it is ready.

event: Days six and seven: legs, hips, back, belly, chest, neck and jaw, each cramping, then settling.
Her heart she can't touch; the tide slides off it, as if it is not yet its turn.

memory.fact: The tide slides off Nala's heart, and she cannot refine it yet.
The tide slides off Nala's heart, and she cannot refine it yet.

event: By the evening of day eight every muscle and tendon she can name is refined whole: a drawn bow.

changes.note: Four days refining every muscle whole with Undertow: a hard working
Muscle refined whole raises her Might by two
Muscle refined whole raises her Speed by one

memory.fact: Muscle by muscle, Nala refines all her muscle and tendon whole in four days, days five to eight.
Muscle by muscle, Nala refines all her muscle and tendon whole in four days, days five to eight.
With all her muscle refined whole, Nala's body feels like a drawn bow.
With all her muscle refined whole, Nala's body feels like a drawn bow.

event: In the night she dreams of Hollow Tarn under a starless sky, a stair of black water going down.

memory.fact: On the night of day eight Nala dreams of the tarn, and a stair of black water going down.
On the night of day eight Nala dreams of the tarn, and a stair of black water going down.
When she is ready, Descent calls in a dream: the tarn, and a stair of black water going down.
On the night of day eight, with skin and muscle whole, Descent first calls Nala in a dream.

event: The cold dark under her well presses up; she wakes heart pounding, the pull still in her chest.

memory.fact: Nala wakes from the tarn dream in the dark, heart pounding, the pull still in her chest.
Nala wakes from the tarn dream in the dark, heart pounding, the pull still in her chest.

event: Day nine: breakfast at the Lantern for a copper; at the smithy she steps to Hob's right side.

changes.note: Breakfast at the Lantern

event: A seven-foot ash shaft, a dark leaf-shaped head, a crossbar; the weight sits forward.

memory.fact: Nala's spear: a seven-foot ash shaft, a dark leaf-shaped cold-iron head, a crossbar below.
Nala's spear: a seven-foot ash shaft, a dark leaf-shaped cold-iron head, a crossbar below.
The spear is heavier at the head than the watch spear, balanced for bracing against a charge.
The spear is heavier at the head than the watch spear, balanced for bracing against a charge.

event: "Cold iron bites the Sea-twisted where plain iron cuts. Keep it oiled." She pays the other half bar.

changes.note: The other half bar to Hob for the cold-iron spear

make.title: Cold-Iron Boar Spear
make.description: A long ash boar spear whose dark, dull cold-iron head has a crossbar below the blade.

changes.note: Hob hands over the cold-iron boar spear

memory.fact: Hob says cold iron bites the Sea-twisted where plain iron only cuts, and bids her keep it oiled.
Hob says cold iron bites the Sea-twisted where plain iron only cuts, and bids her keep it oiled.
Hob asks the other half silver bar when he hands Nala the spear, and not a copper more.
Hob asks the other half silver bar when he hands Nala the spear, and not a copper more.

event: The head sits in her sense as a dead, numb patch; Undertow won't touch it, but drives her arms.

memory.fact: Held, the spear's head sits in Nala's sense as a dead, numb patch at the end of the shaft.
Held, the spear's head sits in Nala's sense as a dead, numb patch at the end of the shaft.
Undertow cannot touch the cold-iron head, but it still drives Nala's arms behind a thrust.
Undertow cannot touch the cold-iron head, but it still drives Nala's arms behind a thrust.

event: At the shrine she tells Anselm her skin and muscle are whole in four days; he sets his broom down.

memory.fact: Anselm is stunned Nala's muscle is whole in four days; his skin alone took him three years.
Anselm is stunned Nala's muscle is whole in four days; his skin alone took him three years.

event: Refining runs outside in: skin, muscle, bone, organs, blood; most Descend once muscle is whole.

memory.fact: Anselm teaches that refining goes outside in: skin, then muscle, bone, organs, and last blood.
Anselm teaches that refining goes outside in: skin, then muscle, bone, organs, and last blood.
Anselm says most Talented Descend once skin and muscle are whole, and refine bone after.
Anselm says most Talented Descend once skin and muscle are whole, and refine bone after.

event: Each part refined first eases the Tribulation; he knows no practice for bone, only that it's slow.

memory.fact: Anselm says each part refined before a Descent makes its Tribulation easier to bear.
Anselm says each part refined before a Descent makes its Tribulation easier to bear.
Anselm knows no Keeper practice for bone; he has heard it aches deep and goes slow.
Anselm knows no Keeper practice for bone; he has heard it aches deep and goes slow.

event: The canticles say Descent calls in a dream of water going down. Has it called her yet?

memory.fact: The canticles say Descent first calls in a dream of water going down, once the body is ready.
The canticles say Descent first calls in a dream of water going down, once the body is ready.

event: A few times; she'll answer when ready and not before. His shoulders drop with relief.

memory.fact: Anselm is relieved Nala waits; the canticles praise one who answers the call only when ready.
Anselm is relieved Nala waits; the canticles praise one who answers the call only when ready.

event: The call doesn't compel; it comes stronger until answered, where the dream shows or in still water.

memory.fact: Anselm says the call does not compel; it comes again, stronger, until it is answered.
Anselm says the call does not compel; it comes again, stronger, until it is answered.
The canticles say one answers the call where the dream shows, or in still, quiet water.
The canticles say one answers the call where the dream shows, or in still, quiet water.

event: A botched Descent can maim or kill; tell him first, and wait for the senior Keeper to guide her.

memory.fact: Anselm begs Nala not to Descend in haste; a botched Descent can maim or kill.
Anselm begs Nala not to Descend in haste; a botched Descent can maim or kill.
Anselm asks Nala to tell him before she answers the call, so someone knows where she went.
Anselm asks Nala to tell him before she answers the call, so someone knows where she went.
Anselm thinks the senior Keeper from Carrowmouth could guide Nala's Descent, if she waits.
Anselm thinks the senior Keeper from Carrowmouth could guide Nala's Descent, if she waits.

event: Back at the cottage she begins her bones, smallest to largest; each drinks the tide slowly.

memory.fact: With Undertow, Nala can refine bone one bone at a time, but bone drinks the tide slowly.
With Undertow, Nala can refine bone one bone at a time, but bone drinks the tide slowly.

event: The three tiny bones of each ear go first, in minutes; after, every sound rings a shade clearer.

memory.fact: The three tiny bones of each ear refine first, in minutes; after, sounds ring a shade clearer.
The three tiny bones of each ear refine first, in minutes; after, sounds ring a shade clearer.

event: Fingers and toes, many a day; each bone aches in the marrow like a fever, then goes heavy and still.

memory.fact: Each bone Nala refines aches deep in the marrow, like a fever, before it goes heavy and still.
Each bone Nala refines aches deep in the marrow, like a fever, before it goes heavy and still.
A refined bone feels heavy and still, like stone under water; she weighs a little more.
A refined bone feels heavy and still, like stone under water; she weighs a little more.

event: She craves salt, milk and bone broth, and runs hot at night; Maddy keeps a pot of broth on for her.

memory.fact: Refining bone gives Nala a craving for salt, milk and bone broth, and she runs hot at night.
Refining bone gives Nala a craving for salt, milk and bone broth, and she runs hot at night.
Maddy at the Lantern keeps a pot of bone broth on for Nala while she refines her bones.
Maddy at the Lantern keeps a pot of bone broth on for Nala while she refines her bones.

event: Each night the dream of the tarn's black stair comes again, stronger.

memory.fact: The dream of the tarn's black stair comes again each night, stronger, until Nala answers it.
The dream of the tarn's black stair comes again each night, stronger, until Nala answers it.

event: Day eleven, market day: the carrier's cart comes up the valley, and Anselm finds her on the green.

memory.fact: Day eleven is market day; the carrier's cart comes up the valley road to the green.
Day eleven is market day; the carrier's cart comes up the valley road to the green.
On day eleven the carrier brings Anselm the Keepers' reply to his letter about Nala.
On day eleven the carrier brings Anselm the Keepers' reply to his letter about Nala.

event: Senior Keeper Maud Ashby comes once the road dries, by month's end; keep her near, and undescended.

memory.fact: The Keepers write that Senior Keeper Maud Ashby will come up the valley once the road dries.
The Keepers write that Senior Keeper Maud Ashby will come up the valley once the road dries.
The Carrow road is expected dry enough for Keeper Ashby by the end of the month.
The Carrow road is expected dry enough for Keeper Ashby by the end of the month.
The Keepers bid Anselm keep Nala near, and keep her from Descending until Keeper Ashby comes.
The Keepers bid Anselm keep Nala near, and keep her from Descending until Keeper Ashby comes.

event: By noon her ear bones, fingers, toes and other small bones are refined whole.

memory.fact: By noon on day eleven Nala's ear bones, fingers, toes and other small bones are refined whole.
By noon on day eleven Nala's ear bones, fingers, toes and other small bones are refined whole.

event: Among the stalls a boy hawks whittled whistles: thin, freckled, thirteen, in a too-big coat.

memory.fact: The boy who watched Nala on market day was hawking whittled whistles among the stalls.
The boy who watched Nala on market day was hawking whittled whistles among the stalls.
Pip is a thin, freckled boy of thirteen in a too-big coat, who sells whittled whistles.
Pip is a thin, freckled boy of thirteen in a too-big coat, who sells whittled whistles.
On day eleven, market day, Crake sends Pip into Wendle Ford to look Nala over.

event: He watches her, not the buyers; she looks straight at him, and he's gone down the valley road.

memory.fact: On market day a thin, freckled boy of thirteen in a too-big coat watched Nala, then fled downvalley.
On market day a thin, freckled boy of thirteen in a too-big coat watched Nala, then fled downvalley.

event: She keeps her routine: broth at the Lantern, then hours refining bone; hands, feet, then each rib.
Her spine is worst: each vertebra sends a cold shock down her limbs, and she sits through each.

memory.fact: Refining her spine, each vertebra sends a cold shock down her limbs that she must sit through.
Refining her spine, each vertebra sends a cold shock down her limbs that she must sit through.

event: By the second week she wakes from the stair dream each night, cold and salt-damp.

memory.fact: Ignored, the dream grows: by the second week Nala wakes from it each night, cold and salt-damp.
Ignored, the dream grows: by the second week Nala wakes from it each night, cold and salt-damp.

event: By day sixteen her hands, feet, ribs and spine are whole; skull, hips and long bones remain.

changes.note: A week refining her small bones, ribs and spine: a hard working

memory.fact: By day sixteen Nala's hands, feet, ribs and spine are refined; skull, hips and long bones remain.
By day sixteen Nala's hands, feet, ribs and spine are refined; skull, hips and long bones remain.

event: At the Lantern over broth, the door bangs: a red-eyed, mud-spattered woman asks for the healer.

changes.note: Broth and meals at the Lantern, days eleven to sixteen

memory.fact: On day sixteen a stranger begs Nala at the Lantern to heal her fevered son at Ashlin Farm.
On day sixteen a stranger begs Nala at the Lantern to heal her fevered son at Ashlin Farm.
On day sixteen a weeping woman comes to the Ford begging a healer for her son at Ashlin Farm.
Knowing she is wary now, Crake means to draw Nala out of the Ford with a plea she will answer.

event: Her boy at Ashlin Farm, half a day off, burns with fever; her tears are real, her eyes on the door.

memory.fact: The begging woman says Ashlin Farm is half a day down the road; she paused over her son's age.
The begging woman says Ashlin Farm is half a day down the road; she paused over her son's age.
Pleading, the woman's tears look real, but her eyes keep going to the Lantern's door.
Pleading, the woman's tears look real, but her eyes keep going to the Lantern's door.

event: "How old's the boy?" A breath too long: "Eight. Nine come summer."

memory.fact: Asked, the woman says her son is eight, nine come summer.
Asked, the woman says her son is eight, nine come summer.
Bet Loddon is a poor liar: she does not know the boy's age, and no one in the Ford knows her.

event: Maddy murmurs she's never seen her before, and knows most faces in the valley.

memory.fact: Maddy knows most faces in the valley, and has never seen the begging woman before.
Maddy knows most faces in the valley, and has never seen the begging woman before.

event: Nala walks her to the Reeve's; she whitens and tries to twist free, but Nala's grip holds.

Led to the Reeve by the arm, Bet goes white and tries to twist free, but Nala's grip holds.

event: She tells Dray the woman is likely leading her to the bandits; he looks her over, and believes it.

memory.fact: Dray believes Nala at once, and wants Crake for the ten-bar price and the three lost Talented.
Dray believes Nala at once, and wants Crake for the ten-bar price and the three lost Talented.

memory.fact: When Dray names Crake to her face, Bet breaks and weeps, and begs them not to kill her brothers.
When Dray names Crake to her face, Bet breaks and weeps, and begs them not to kill her brothers.

event: She is Bet Loddon; she has no son, Crake paid her two silver, and she fears him.

memory.fact: The woman is Bet Loddon, the Loddon brothers' sister, and her son's fever is a story Crake paid for.
The woman is Bet Loddon, the Loddon brothers' sister, and her son's fever is a story Crake paid for.
Bet has no son; she came for her brothers' sake, and for two silver Crake paid her.
Bet has no son; she came for her brothers' sake, and for two silver Crake paid her.
Bet is afraid of Crake, and more afraid of what he would do to her brothers if she failed.
Bet is afraid of Crake, and more afraid of what he would do to her brothers if she failed.

event: All of them wait at Ashlin Farm, empty since autumn: Crake and four men.

memory.fact: Pressed, Bet tells that Crake and all four of his men wait at Ashlin Farm, which is empty.
Pressed, Bet tells that Crake and all four of his men wait at Ashlin Farm, which is empty.
Its folk left for Carrowmouth last autumn, and the farm has been empty all winter.
Its folk left for Carrowmouth last autumn, and the farm has been empty all winter.
Ashlin Farm lies empty half a day down the valley road, its folk gone to Carrowmouth last autumn.

event: Her brothers in the hayloft with crossbows, Big Harl by the hearth with Crake, Pip on the road.

memory.fact: Bet tells that her brothers lie in the barn's hayloft with crossbows on the yard below.
Bet tells that her brothers lie in the barn's hayloft with crossbows on the yard below.

Bet tells that Big Harl waits inside the farmhouse, and Crake with him, by the hearth.

event: She's to bring Nala up the front lane by dusk, a lamp lit when ready; if she's late, he moves.

Bet is to bring Nala alone up the front lane before dusk; a lamp in the window means all is ready.

If Bet is not back at Ashlin Farm by nightfall, Crake will judge it gone wrong and break camp.

event: Dray knows Ashlin: a beck gully reaches the barn's back wall unseen. He'll turn the trap.

Dray knows Ashlin Farm: empty since autumn, with a beck gully behind its barn.

Behind the farm, Ashlin Beck runs in a wooded gully that reaches the back of the barn unseen.
From the beck gully a man can reach the barn's back wall without crossing open ground.
From the beck gully a man can reach the barn's back wall without crossing open ground.

Dray would turn the trap: Nala walks in as bait while he and the watch come up the beck behind.

event: Stone has no skin for Crake to drink through; they must leave by noon. Will she walk in as bait?

Dray reckons Crake's touch cannot drink through Stonehand, since stone has no skin.

Dray says they must leave the Ford by noon to reach Ashlin Farm before dusk.

Dray means to strike before nightfall, before Crake guesses Bet has failed and moves camp.

event: Gladly, with her new spear; a spear on a lone traveller won't alarm anyone on a road with wolves.

memory.fact: A spear in a lone traveller's hand alarms no one; Crake's men expect one on a road with wolves.
A spear in a lone traveller's hand alarms no one; Crake's men expect one on a road with wolves.

event: Stop at the lane's end and talk to hold the bows' eyes; a single crow's caw means he's at the wall.

Dray tells Nala to stop at the lane's end and talk, to hold the crossbows' eyes while he closes.

event: An hour later Dray and four watchmen slip out east across the fields, behind the hedgerows.

event: At noon Nala sets off down the valley road with Bet, the cold-iron spear on her shoulder.

event: Bet walks close, eyes down; Nala watches hedges and road, and sees no one.

On the road to Ashlin Farm, Nala watches the hedges and the road ahead and sees no one.

Bet walks down the road beside Nala, too frightened to give Crake's men a sign either way.

On the road Bet asks Nala, low, whether her brothers will hang.

Bet swears not to give it away, hands shaking: Wil will listen to her if it goes badly for Crake.

memory.fact: Given hope, Bet steadies, and means to call her brothers by name once the fight turns.
Given hope, Bet steadies, and means to call her brothers by name once the fight turns.

Bet says her brother Wil will listen to her, and she will call to him if it goes badly for Crake.

event: The light goes amber, then grey; at a hedged lane's end a lamp burns in a farmhouse window.

memory.fact: At dusk a lamp burns in the farmhouse window, the sign Crake's men are ready.
At dusk a lamp burns in the farmhouse window, the sign Crake's men are ready.

event: A low farmhouse, a stone barn across a yard of trodden mud; the hayloft door looks down the lane.

memory.fact: A long, low stone farmhouse faces a stone barn across an open yard of trodden mud.
A long, low stone farmhouse faces a stone barn across an open yard of trodden mud.
The barn's hayloft door looks straight down on the yard and the end of the lane.
The barn's hayloft door looks straight down on the yard and the end of the lane.

event: No crow's caw yet; she walks the lane, Bet a step behind, and out past the hedges into the yard.

memory.fact: The lane runs a long bowshot between hedges and opens on the yard with no cover at its end.
The lane runs a long bowshot between hedges and opens on the yard with no cover at its end.

event: Her refined ears catch a crossbow creak in the loft, and keys jangling in the dark barn below it.

memory.fact: Someone with jangling keys waits in the dark of the barn under the loft, not by the house hearth.
Someone with jangling keys waits in the dark of the barn under the loft, not by the house hearth.
Crake now waits in the barn under the loft, and the Loddons shoot as soon as she clears the lane.

event: Two strings thrum; she throws herself sideways, and two bolts bury themselves where her legs stood.

memory.fact: As two crossbows thrummed from the loft, Nala threw herself sideways, and both bolts missed her.
As two crossbows thrummed from the loft, Nala threw herself sideways, and both bolts missed her.
The loft's first two bolts were aimed low, at Nala's legs, not at her heart.
The loft's first two bolts were aimed low, at Nala's legs, not at her heart.
Crake's orders: once the mark is in the yard, the Loddons shoot for her legs, to pin, not kill.

event: Behind her Bet presses flat against the hedge at the lane's mouth, untouched; the loft winds again.

memory.fact: When the loft shot at Nala, Bet pressed flat against the hedge at the lane's mouth, untouched.
When the loft shot at Nala, Bet pressed flat against the hedge at the lane's mouth, untouched.
The Loddons need about ten breaths to wind and reload their crossbows.

event: From the gully, a man's roar where the caw should be, and iron ringing on iron: someone was waiting.

memory.fact: Someone was waiting on Dray's path in the beck gully; iron rang there instead of a crow's caw.
Someone was waiting on Dray's path in the beck gully; iron rang there instead of a crow's caw.
Warier, Crake posts Big Harl in the beck gully behind the barn, to watch the back way.

event: A soft voice from the barn: "Nimble. Put the spear down, healer, and nobody bleeds tonight."

memory.fact: A soft voice from the barn bids Nala put the spear down, and promises nobody bleeds tonight.
A soft voice from the barn bids Nala put the spear down, and promises nobody bleeds tonight.

event: She charges the twenty paces of yard; in the dim barn stands a lean, smiling man, keys at his belt.

memory.fact: The yard is some twenty paces across from the lane's end to the barn's wide doorway.
The yard is some twenty paces across from the lane's end to the barn's wide doorway.
The barn is dim inside, its floor strewn with straw.
The barn is dim inside, its floor strewn with straw.
Crake is lean, soft-spoken and smiling, and a ring of keys jangles at his belt.
Crake is lean, soft-spoken and smiling, and a ring of keys jangles at his belt.

event: Her spear takes Crake in the chest but grinds on rings under his jerkin; he slams into a post.

memory.fact: A coat of rings under Crake's jerkin armours his chest and belly; Nala's spear point grinds on it.
A coat of rings under Crake's jerkin armours his chest and belly; Nala's spear point grinds on it.
Nala's spear thrust lifted Crake off his feet and slammed him against a barn post.
Nala's spear thrust lifted Crake off his feet and slammed him against a barn post.
Crake wears a short coat of saltsteel rings under his jerkin, over chest and belly.

event: He comes off the post along the shaft, bare hands reaching; she wrenches the spear to keep them off.

memory.fact: Charged, Crake slips aside and reaches along the spear shaft for the hands that hold it.
Charged, Crake slips aside and reaches along the spear shaft for the hands that hold it.
Crake fights bare-handed, with a long knife at his hip he seldom draws; his touch is the weapon.
Crake fights bare-handed, with a long knife at his hip he seldom draws; his touch is the weapon.

event: His left hand flicks from his cuff: a needle dart breaks the skin of her neck, and cold creeps in.

changes.note: Crake's needle dart pricks her neck

memory.fact: A needle dart from Crake's left cuff broke the skin of Nala's neck; cold creeps toward her Locks.
A needle dart from Crake's left cuff broke the skin of Nala's neck; cold creeps toward her Locks.
Crake's cuff dart is the one Dray warned of; its venom chokes a Talent's Locks.
Crake's cuff dart is the one Dray warned of; its venom chokes a Talent's Locks.
Crake keeps two venom darts in his left cuff and flicks one at bare skin when he can.

event: "There. Now we wait a minute, you and I." Overhead, two crossbow strings click home.

memory.fact: The venom chokes Nala's Locks within the minute; she has that long to use Undertow at all.
The venom chokes Nala's Locks within the minute; she has that long to use Undertow at all.
Crake keeps his chin tucked to his ring coat in a fight; the neck is a narrow mark.
Crake keeps his chin tucked to his ring coat in a fight; the neck is a narrow mark.
Coralsnout venom in a wound chokes a Talent's Locks within a minute, and holds them shut for hours.

event: She throws Undertow at his bare head like a rope and hauls; his chin jerks up off the rings.

changes.note: Hauling Crake's head and driving the spear with Undertow

memory.fact: Crake's bare head is open to Undertow: a hard pull can yank it down and forward like a rope.
Crake's bare head is open to Undertow: a hard pull can yank it down and forward like a rope.
Crake's bare head, neck, hands and legs lie open to Undertow; only the saltsteel shields him.

event: Undertow drives her arms; the cold iron takes his bare neck, and after a breath his skin gives.

memory.fact: Undertow cannot touch the cold-iron head, but driving Nala's own arms it speeds her thrust.
Undertow cannot touch the cold-iron head, but driving Nala's own arms it speeds her thrust.
A cold-iron point driven hard into Crake's bare neck breaks his First Depth skin.
A cold-iron point driven hard into Crake's bare neck breaks his First Depth skin.
Crake's First Depth skin turns a plain blade; only a hard, true thrust breaks it.

event: His hands find only wood and cold iron to drink; he sags off the point, his stolen Water spilling.

memory.fact: Dying, Crake's hands found nothing to drink from on Nala's spear: only wood and cold iron.
Dying, Crake's hands found nothing to drink from on Nala's spear: only wood and cold iron.
Speared through the neck, Crake dies in moments, and his reservoir spills out as cold brine.
Speared through the neck, Crake dies in moments, and his reservoir spills out as cold brine.
Nala killed Crake in Ashlin Farm's barn, her Undertow-driven spear through his bare neck.
Nala killed Crake in Ashlin Farm's barn, her Undertow-driven spear through his bare neck.

event: Bet cries from the lane: "Wil! He's down! Put it down!" One crossbow clatters, then the other.

memory.fact: If Crake falls, Bet cries out to Wil from the lane, and Wil lowers his crossbow; Kit follows.
If Crake falls, Bet cries out to Wil from the lane, and Wil lowers his crossbow; Kit follows.
After Crake fell and Bet called to Wil, both crossbows in the loft clattered down.
After Crake fell and Bet called to Wil, both crossbows in the loft clattered down.

event: The farmhouse door bangs, and small feet run for the hedges; the gully goes to shouting and a howl.

memory.fact: When Crake fell, someone small ran from the farmhouse for the hedges.
When Crake fell, someone small ran from the farmhouse for the hedges.
As Crake died, the fight in the beck gully had gone to shouting and a man's howl of pain.
As Crake died, the fight in the beck gully had gone to shouting and a man's howl of pain.
Pip keeps to the farmhouse with the lamp, and runs for the road if the fight turns.

event: The cold in her neck is nearly at her Locks; her Water answers, only just, for seconds.

memory.fact: As Crake died, the venom's cold lay heavy in Nala's neck, seconds from choking her Locks.
As Crake died, the venom's cold lay heavy in Nala's neck, seconds from choking her Locks.

event: She Pushes out through the prick, slow as cold mud; dark bitter fluid beads, but the dart stays.

changes.note: Pushing hard against the venom

memory.fact: Nala's push against the venom came slow, like pushing through cold mud, and too late.
Nala's push against the venom came slow, like pushing through cold mud, and too late.
Nala's Push beaded dark, bitter fluid at the prick and shifted the dart, but did not free it.
Nala's Push beaded dark, bitter fluid at the prick and shifted the dart, but did not free it.

event: The cold reaches her Locks; throat, palms, soles clench shut, and the Push dies in her.

memory.fact: The venom choked all Nala's Locks, throat, palms and soles; the dart stayed in her neck.
The venom choked all Nala's Locks, throat, palms and soles; the dart stayed in her neck.

event: Her Water is penned in her well; no Undertow, no sense of water, but her refined body still holds.

memory.fact: With her Locks choked, Nala cannot sense water around her, nor cycle, nor refine.
With her Locks choked, Nala cannot sense water around her, nor cycle, nor refine.
Locks choked, Nala's Water stays penned in her well: no Undertow, but her refined body holds.
Locks choked, Nala's Water stays penned in her well: no Undertow, but her refined body holds.

event: From the loft, steady and hoarse: both bows are down; may they come down the ladder?

memory.fact: From the loft Wil calls that both bows are down, and asks leave to come down the ladder unarmed.
From the loft Wil calls that both bows are down, and asks leave to come down the ladder unarmed.

event: Out in the lane Bet is sobbing; behind the barn the gully has gone quiet.

memory.fact: After Crake fell, Bet stood sobbing out in Ashlin Farm's lane.
After Crake fell, Bet stood sobbing out in Ashlin Farm's lane.
After Crake fell, the beck gully behind Ashlin Farm's barn went quiet.
After Crake fell, the beck gully behind Ashlin Farm's barn went quiet.

event: A broad, bearded man comes down first, hands open; a thin, wild-eyed younger one follows, shaking.

memory.fact: Wil Loddon, about twenty-eight, is broad and bearded, slow-spoken and steady.
Wil Loddon, about twenty-eight, is broad and bearded, slow-spoken and steady.
Kit Loddon, about nineteen, is thin and wild-eyed, and shakes as he comes down the ladder.
Kit Loddon, about nineteen, is thin and wild-eyed, and shakes as he comes down the ladder.

event: Both kneel unbidden: no one else, Wil says, but Big Harl in the gully and Pip, who ran.

memory.fact: The brothers come down with empty hands held open, Wil first, and kneel in the straw unbidden.
The brothers come down with empty hands held open, Wil first, and kneel in the straw unbidden.
Wil says no one else is at Ashlin but Big Harl in the gully and the boy Pip, who ran.
Wil says no one else is at Ashlin but Big Harl in the gully and the boy Pip, who ran.

event: Wil eyes the dart: the venom shuts a Talent's Locks till about dawn, no longer.

memory.fact: Wil knows the dart in Nala's neck: the venom shuts a Talent's Locks till about dawn, no longer.
Wil knows the dart in Nala's neck: the venom shuts a Talent's Locks till about dawn, no longer.

event: Bet stumbles in and drops beside her brothers, holding the younger one's head to her.

memory.fact: When her brothers yield, Bet drops beside them and holds the younger one's head to her.
When her brothers yield, Bet drops beside them and holds the younger one's head to her.

event: Dray comes round the barn, fists still stone; Big Harl bound and limping, a watchman's arm bleeding.

memory.fact: Dray comes round the barn soon after, Big Harl bound and limping, Rob Reed's arm bleeding.
Dray comes round the barn soon after, Big Harl bound and limping, Rob Reed's arm bleeding.
In the gully Big Harl's axe lays open Rob Reed's arm before Dray's stone fists break Harl's arm.

event: Wil: Crake keeps three Talented chained in a Salt Lanes cellar; he'll name it for their two lives.

memory.fact: Wil knows Crake keeps three Talented chained in a cellar in Carrowmouth's Salt Lanes.
Wil knows Crake keeps three Talented chained in a cellar in Carrowmouth's Salt Lanes.
Wil will tell which cellar in the Salt Lanes, if it buys his and Kit's lives.
Wil will tell which cellar in the Salt Lanes, if it buys his and Kit's lives.
Crake has three Talented captives chained in a cellar in Carrowmouth's Salt Lanes.
Crake has three Talented captives chained in a cellar in Carrowmouth's Salt Lanes.

event: As she tells it, the grey fades from Dray's fists: "I've seen First Depth fighters do less."

memory.fact: As Dray hears out Nala's tale of the fight, the grey fades from his fists back to flesh.
As Dray hears out Nala's tale of the fight, the grey fades from his fists back to flesh.
Hearing how Nala took Crake, Dray says he has seen First Depth fighters do less.
Hearing how Nala took Crake, Dray says he has seen First Depth fighters do less.

event: She speaks for the Loddons; robbers hang, but one who yields and names his master goes to the mines.

memory.fact: Under the Reeve's law robbers hang; one who yields and names his master may go to the mines.
Under the Reeve's law robbers hang; one who yields and names his master may go to the mines.

event: If the cellar proves true, Dray writes Lady Varrow: three years in the Keep's quarry, not the rope.

memory.fact: Dray will write Lady Varrow for clemency for the Loddons, if Wil's cellar proves true.
Dray will write Lady Varrow for clemency for the Loddons, if Wil's cellar proves true.
Dray would have the Loddon brothers serve Varrow Keep's quarry three years, under guard, not hang.
Dray would have the Loddon brothers serve Varrow Keep's quarry three years, under guard, not hang.

event: Bet's no robber: she speaks before the Lady, then goes home. She weeps again, differently now.

memory.fact: Dray judges Bet no robber; she may go home to Carrowmouth once she has spoken before Lady Varrow.
Dray judges Bet no robber; she may go home to Carrowmouth once she has spoken before Lady Varrow.
Hearing her brothers spared the rope, Bet bends over them weeping again, but differently now.
Hearing her brothers spared the rope, Bet bends over them weeping again, but differently now.

event: Wil murmurs the cellar's place to Dray; a rider goes to the Carrowmouth watch at first light.

memory.fact: Wil murmured to Dray where in the Salt Lanes Crake's cellar lies.
Wil murmured to Dray where in the Salt Lanes Crake's cellar lies.
Dray sends a rider to the Carrowmouth watch at first light with Wil's cellar, to free the captives.
Dray sends a rider to the Carrowmouth watch at first light with Wil's cellar, to free the captives.

event: By the door the bound man spits: "Not you, Harl. You hang, unless you've something worth your neck."

memory.fact: Big Harl gets no clemency from Dray; he will hang, unless he too names something worth his neck.
Big Harl gets no clemency from Dray; he will hang, unless he too names something worth his neck.

event: Crake's head is worth five bars dead, all hers; they bed down here, and he goes home on a hurdle.

memory.fact: With Crake dead, the Carrowmouth watch pays five bars on proof; Dray says the price is all Nala's.
With Crake dead, the Carrowmouth watch pays five bars on proof; Dray says the price is all Nala's.
Dray means to spend the night at Ashlin Farm and march his prisoners up the valley at dawn.
Dray means to spend the night at Ashlin Farm and march his prisoners up the valley at dawn.
The Pell twins carry Crake's body home from Ashlin Farm on a hurdle at dawn.
The Pell twins carry Crake's body home from Ashlin Farm on a hurdle at dawn.
Crake's body goes back to the Ford on a hurdle, for the Carrowmouth watch to see.
Crake's body goes back to the Ford on a hurdle, for the Carrowmouth watch to see.
The Carrowmouth price on Crake is ten silver bars alive, and five for proof he is dead.

event: The wounded watchman sits grey-faced on a bucket while another binds his slashed forearm.
Wil, low: Pip will run for the Grey Shaw tollhouse, Crake's camp, to grab the stash and vanish.

memory.fact: Wil reckons Pip runs for Grey Shaw, to grab what he can of Crake's stash and vanish.
Wil reckons Pip runs for Grey Shaw, to grab what he can of Crake's stash and vanish.
Crake's stash at the Grey Shaw tollhouse holds bottled stolen Water, coin, and his ledger.
Crake's stash at the Grey Shaw tollhouse holds bottled stolen Water, coin, and his ledger.
Pip reaches the Grey Shaw tollhouse near midnight, a full day's walk on the road.
